integrity.proof_scope: All lengths n>=2 at the first position; n=2,3 separately and all lengths n>=4 at the second position. A full symbolic graph proof supports the infinite claim; finite exact checks are corroborative only.

scientific_limitations: Exactly one wildcard in the first or second indexed position of a binary linear universal partial word, and their reversals. No higher alphabet, multiple wildcard, arbitrary interior position, cyclic setting, or historical-priority certification is claimed.
title: Exact enumeration of boundary-joker binary universal partial words
